# Is it worth grading? Which of these cards should you send, and which should you sell raw?

> Is it worth grading this card? Paste your cards with your own value at each grade and grade chances and get which to send to a grader, which fee tier, which to sell raw, the break-even chance of a 10 and the downside. Pokemon, baseball, basketball and MTG. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
